data.description:
## Incident Overview

### Scenario Type
P3 — CI flake. Recurring across PRs; each rerun fixes (the failure is non-deterministic).

### Expected Behavior
`tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main.sh` should pass deterministically across parallel CI workers and consecutive rerunds within the 4h state-file freshness window. Bug 402e-5bc3 (closed) was meant to eliminate this exact class of flake via per-process BRANCH-tag suffixing.

### Actual Behavior
Observed during 2026-05-17 batch-fix + retro-review-remediation session: **5 distinct PRs** (#185, #194, #198, #201, #211) hit `Script Tests` failures with `test-merge-to-main.sh FAIL (N pass, M fail)`. The failing test name varies across runs:

| PR | Failing test names |
|---|---|
| #185 | test_state_write_phase_overwrites_previous |
| #194 | (similar state-file PARSE_ERROR) |
| #198 | test-merge-to-main-ucq2 / version-bump (sibling files) |
| #201 | test_state_completed_phases_populated |
| #211 | test_state_mark_complete_appends_phase, test_state_mark_complete_sets_phase_status, test_sigurg_records_interrupted_phase |

Every case shows `expected: <value> | actual: FAIL: python parse error` — the python3 read of the /tmp state file fails (FileNotFoundError or partial JSON).

### Why 402e-5bc3 Did Not Fully Resolve

402e-5bc3 added `_TEST_BRANCH_TAG="$$-${RANDOM}"` and suffixed all BRANCH= assignments at the time of the fix. But:
1. New tests/assertions added after that fix may not have picked up the tag pattern
2. Sibling test files (`test-merge-to-main-ucq2.sh`, `test-merge-to-main-version-bump.sh`) have the same hazard with their own static BRANCH names; their tests use `BRANCH="test-conflict-integ-$$"` style but the failure modes flagged on PR #198 suggest those static names still collide in some CI conditions
3. The underlying `_state_init` in `plugins/dso/hooks/lib/merge-helpers.sh` does `find /tmp -maxdepth 1 -name 'merge-to-main-state-*.json' -mmin +240 -delete` on every call — a process-wide side effect that can interact unpredictably with concurrent test workers

### Reproduction
Hard to reproduce locally (passes ~100% locally). CI-only flake under suite-engine parallelization. Visible only in retrospect via failed CI runs.

### Suggested Fix Directions
1. Sweep `test-merge-to-main.sh` (and siblings `test-merge-to-main-ucq2.sh`, `test-merge-to-main-version-bump.sh`) for any remaining static BRANCH assignments without the per-process tag; suffix all of them.
2. Parameterize state-file location: introduce a `MERGE_STATE_DIR` env var read by `_state_file_path` in merge-helpers.sh (default `/tmp`); have each test set `MERGE_STATE_DIR=$(mktemp -d)` so /tmp races become structurally impossible. This was considered during 402e-5bc3 fix but deferred as too-broad scope.
3. Remove the `find /tmp -delete` side-effect from `_state_init` — or scope it to `MERGE_STATE_DIR` per (2) so the cleanup cannot delete other processes' files.

### Skills and Workflows
- Affected file: tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main.sh + siblings
- Related closed bug: 402e-5bc3 (incomplete fix)
- Helper: plugins/dso/hooks/lib/merge-helpers.sh (_state_file_path, _state_init)
- Impact: every direct-PR session that touches this codebase hits the flake every ~3-5 PRs
data.title: [tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main.sh]: state-file /tmp race recurs across multiple tests despite 402e-5bc3 BRANCH-suffix fix -> 5 false-failure CI runs in one session
